action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that PDFResurrect did not properly validate certain size
values when loading PDF pages. If a user or automated system were tricked
into opening a specially crafted PDF file, an attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause PDFResurrect to crash, resulting in a denial of
service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2019-14934)

It was discovered that PDFResurrect did not properly validate the header of
PDF files, leading to a heap buffer overflow. If a user or automated system
were tricked into opening a specially crafted PDF file, an attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause PDFResurrect to crash, resulting in a
denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2020-20740)
isummary:
PDFResurrect could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it
opened a specially crafted file.

pdfresurrect.description: tool for extracting versioning data from PDF documents

title: PDFResurrect vulnerabilities
